coordinate_provenance.note: Campus coordinates use Wikidata P625 seed points; city coordinates are manually verified WGS84 centres. They are framing seeds, not authoritative boundaries.

collections.title: All Russell Group universities
collections.methodology: Complete current Russell Group membership. Entries are institutions, not de-duplicated cities, so the five London members remain distinct memorabilia subjects. Positions are alphabetical and are not ranks.

collections.title: All U.S. cities in QS Best Student Cities 2027
collections.methodology: Complete U.S. subset of QS Best Student Cities 2027, ordered by global overall rank. QS requires a qualifying city to exceed 250,000 people and contain at least two universities in the current QS World University Rankings.

collections.title: U.S. top-100 university campus localities omitted by the QS city criterion
collections.methodology: Adds the primary-campus locality of every U.S. institution in the global QS World University Rankings 2027 top 100 when that locality is absent from the QS U.S. student-city list. This restores commercially important smaller college towns without misrepresenting them as ranked QS student cities.

collections.title: Top 25 non-UK European student cities
collections.methodology: First 25 European entries outside the United Kingdom in QS Best Student Cities 2027, ordered by global overall rank. The UK is excluded here because Russell Group institutions have their own collection.

collections.title: 30 globally significant marathon map candidates
collections.methodology: Recurring races from positions 1–30 of the World Athletics 2025 combined men's/women's Marathon Competition Performance Ranking; excludes the one-off #17 Brussels–Leuven European Running Championships route and adds Cape Town because Abbott World Marathon Majors confirmed it as the eighth Major from 2027. Status labels are checked against the 2026 World Athletics Label calendar. This is an auditable elite-performance core, not a popularity poll.

limitations: The World Athletics competition-performance method emphasizes elite fields and results rather than participant demand, heritage, scenery, or memorabilia appeal.
A combined men's/women's ranking disadvantages women-only races; Nagoya Women's Marathon and Osaka Women's Marathon are 2026 Platinum races but are outside this core.
The core has no South American race and should not be presented as geographically representative.
